cost: Individual access/insertion O(n), n<=4096. Standard splay potential sum(log subtree size) gives amortized O(log n) per access/insertion under sequence accounting, including initial potential. No worst-case per-call logarithmic guarantee. O(n) arena and iterative O(1) rotation scratch; keys uses O(height+n) traversal/output.
forward: Locate key with ordinary BST search. Access splays the matching node, or last visited node on miss, using zig/zig-zig/zig-zag rotations. New insert attaches a leaf and splays it; duplicate insert splays the existing node. root and keys only observe state.
inverse: Typed behavior complement, ambiguous reverse reconstruction and specializations in model.md
limitations: Exact bounded APIs only. No generic 1/2/5/10% accuracy surrogate is supported. Finite tests do not prove universal correctness or runtime gains. Standard Vec/Box/BTreeMap allocation failure may abort or panic; allocator refusal is not injected. No callbacks, I/O or concurrency effects.
